title: Timber for the {place}
Beams wanted in {settlement}
summary: The {place} in {settlement} stands half-raised: the builders ran out of timber. Bring {count} × {item} to {giver} and the work goes on.
{settlement} needs timber for its {place}. {count} × {item} will see the frame finished.
offer: We've the walls of the {place} up to the sills and not a beam left to roof it. {count} × {item} would get us going again, and I'll pay above market.
The yard's bare. If you could fetch {count} × {item}, the {place} gets its frame by the week's end.
progress: Still short of timber, I'm afraid. Every log helps.
The saws are idle until the timber comes.
complete: That's the timber! Hear that? The saws are going again.
Good, sound wood. The {place} will be roofed before the rain.
